summary: Comprehensive redesign implementation plan to transform the website into 'Cleaning Service' — a premium, minimalist, conversion-focused residential cleaning sales demo. Features an architectural forest green and warm ivory design system, authentic photography, 3 core services, 2-scene interactive before-and-after image slider, transparent reviews and location coverage, 4 FAQ accordions, dual-mode quote flow (inline section + modal), and a centralized demo config object for effortless client customization.
